_about: The one list of playable games. The JustAskJoe Lab, the Studio home and the PR preview links all read this file, so adding a game is one entry here (plus its builds/ folder). slug: the Lab address (/lab/<slug>/). dir: the game's folder. file: the build in <dir>/builds/. img: true if the build loads art from builds/img/. © 2026 justaskjoe. All rights reserved.

games.name: Tower Defense
games.blurb: Co-op roguelite TD (solo for now): a road that grows, 4 towers, 10 waves, a card draft after each. Menu → Tester tools jumps to any wave.

games.name: Trickbound
games.blurb: Spades spin-off: a trick-taking card adventure with familiars. Leg 1 is playable.

games.name: Tilebound
games.blurb: Mahjong meets the Game Boy Pokémon TCG. Plays with bots.

games.name: Hexed
games.blurb: Witchy tarot match-3: ten levels, a journey map, powers and a coach.

games.name: Neon Surf
games.blurb: Neon-ocean rhythm surfing on an original placeholder beat, with tap-along calibration.

games.name: Gate Runner
games.blurb: Cyberpunk runner shooter on a house beat: steer your squad through gates, shoot the street clear, melt the boss on the drop. Menu has tester jumps.

games.name: Intergalactic Card Trader
games.blurb: Approved pitch: a card shop sim at a galactic trade hub; no build yet.
